description: §19.16.2: each iteration runs its own deferred bodies (LIFO) on fall-through, `continue`, `break` and `return`.
rationale: §19.16.2 Registration: "… a loop body (once per iteration) …"; §19.16.6: "A loop body is its own block, so each iteration has its own stack instance and its deferred statements run at that iteration's exit."
